title: Joyce O NDE 4468
content:
Amazing Life - My Journey Through Life and Death Check it out at: Click Here When I was in an unconscious state in the hospital I felt my soul leave my body. I could hear and see the doctors talking. I heard my mother, John and Dolly, my brother-in-law and sister. I was in a state of wonderful peace where there was a very bright light starting out like the top of a huge ice cream cone and ending at a point. My soul began to move very quickly through the light to the end of the point. There was a figure at the end of the point with outstretched arms. All of a sudden, there was total blackness. They later told me that I was clinically dead. My comment on my death experience is that now I believe that this is heaven on earth. That when we are born we reach the gates of heaven and that when we die that it's not a bad experience but an extremely peaceful one, at least right before you die when you're in the area if the bright light and even when it turns totally black. This is my experience. People that have death or near death experiences may have different opinions. I only know that I love life in spite of the bumps and that I'm not afraid of death. I also feel that I'm living proof that there is life after death. The preceding is a quote from my book.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Very bright light shaped like 'the top of a huge ice cream cone and ending at a point'; moved quickly through it to the end.

arrival.other_being_detail: A figure at the end of the point with outstretched arms.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard mother, brother-in-law, and sister while unconscious; saw/heard doctors talking; encountered a 'figure' at the end of the light; then total blackness.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with hospital perceptions, then movement through bright light to a point with a figure, then total blackness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The bright light is described as shaped like the top of a huge ice cream cone ending at a point; after reaching the figure there was 'total blackness.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was in a state of wonderful peace where there was a very bright light starting out like the top of a huge ice cream cone and ending at a point.”; “There was a figure at the end of the point with outstretched arms.”; “All of a sudden, there was total blackness.”; “I'm not afraid of death.”; “They later told me that I was clinically dead.”
